name: Children's Multivitamin Gummies — 30 Count
short: Multivitamin complex with Vitamins A, C, D, E, B-complex — 30 Gummies. Supports daily nutritional support for children. Available OTC. Bilingual delivery across Los Cabos.
description:
Composition & Indication

Children’s Multivitamin Gummies — 30 Count contains Multivitamin complex with Vitamins A, C, D, E, B-complex as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Gummies at the official 1 gummy daily strength. The standard indication is the management of daily nutritional support for children, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Children’s Multivitamin Gummies is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

For adult use as directed. Consult your healthcare provider if symptoms persist. Authentic product sourced from licensed Mexican distributors. Same-day delivery to Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Los Cabos tourist corridor. Bilingual customer support available 24/7 for visitors and residents.
